Set this claim to Waiting on Customer.

I can't set Waiting on Customer here, because that status only applies to service requests. A claim moves through New, Under Investigation, Appraisal, Approved, Payment Issued, then Closed or Denied, and this one is **Under Investigation** right now.

Do you want to move it to another claim status, such as **Appraisal** now that both estimates are in? Or I can set up a follow-up task to chase Chinedu Okafor for whatever you're waiting on.
